# Therapytips.org

> A comprehensive mental health and psychology resource offering interactive personality assessments, cognitive tests, and expert articles by Dr. Mark Travers.

Therapytips.org provides evidence-based personality quizzes, psychology assessments, and mental health content designed to help users understand themselves better. The site features original tests grounded in psychological research, including Jungian archetypes and cognitive science, alongside educational articles on relationships, decision-making, and personal growth.

## Key Topics

- Personality Assessment
- Self-Discovery
- Cognitive Style
- Emotional Intelligence
- Jungian Psychology
- Archetype Assessment
- Mental Health
- Psychology Quizzes
- Decision-Making
- Flow State
- Emotional Labor
- Sensory Sensitivity
- Mythic Mentor Archetype
- Big Five Traits
- Interactive Assessment

## Personality & Self-Discovery Tests

- [Personality Tests](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests): Catalog of personality and psychology assessments curated by mental health professionals
- [Mythic Mentor Archetype Quiz](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests/mythic-mentor-archetype-quiz.html): Jungian psychology archetype quiz revealing mythic mentor based on Big Five traits
- [Cognitive Style Test](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests/cognitive-style-test.html): Cognitive Style Test by Dr. Travers identifying 8 thinking patterns and mental processing
- [Emotional Labor Index](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests/emotional-labor-index.html): Emotional Labor Index assessing social energy management and burnout risk factors
- [Highly Sensitive Person Quiz](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests/highly-sensitive-person-quiz.html): Quiz measuring sensory processing sensitivity, emotional depth, and overstimulation
- [Flow State Test](https://therapytips.org/personality-tests/flow-state-test.html): Flow State Test by Dr. Travers measuring focus, concentration, and deep work capacity

## Psychology & Mental Health Articles

- [Articles](https://therapytips.org/articles): Collection of mental health articles, psychology insights, and personal growth content
- [A Psychologist Says You Don't Need Therapy To Understand Yourself](https://therapytips.org/articles/a-psychologist-says-you-dont-need-therapy-to-understand-yourself.html): Article by Dr. Travers on self-understanding through personality, emotions, and attachment
- [1 Test That Tells You If You're Ready For Growth](https://therapytips.org/articles/1-test-that-tells-you-if-youre-ready-for-growth.html): Article on growth mindset and change readiness with Growth Comfort Test by Dr. Travers
- [This Psychology-Inspired Quiz Helps You Discover Your 'Mythic Mentor'](https://therapytips.org/articles/this-psychologyinspired-quiz-helps-you-discover-your-mythic-mentor.html): Article on mythic mentor archetypes, Jungian psychology, and psychological strengths
- [What's Your Decision-Making Blind Spot?](https://therapytips.org/articles/whats-your-decisionmaking-blind-spot.html): Article on cognitive biases and decision-making blind spots with assessment quiz

## Relationships & Behavioral Psychology

- [A Psychologist Shares A Quiz To Reveal Your Dating 'Ick Factor'](https://therapytips.org/articles/a-psychologist-shares-a-quiz-to-reveal-your-dating-ick-factor.html): Dating psychology article on disgust sensitivity and relationship preferences by Dr. Travers
- [Are You A Morning Lark Or A Midnight Creative?](https://therapytips.org/articles/are-you-a-morning-lark-or-a-midnight-creative.html): Article on chronotype and circadian rhythms with Internal Clock Test by Dr. Travers
- [3 Reasons Being A Flawless Parent Backfires](https://therapytips.org/advice/3-reasons-being-a-flawless-parent-backfires.html): Parenting advice on modeling behavior, accountability, and child emotional development

## Research & Interviews

- [University Of Liverpool Research Reveals What Really Motivates Young Adults On Tinder](https://therapytips.org/interviews/university-of-liverpool-research-reveals-what-really-motivates-young-adults-on-tinder.html): Interview with researcher on Tinder motivations, self-esteem, and digital dating psychology
- [New Research Reveals How People Make Moral Choices In A Real-Life Sacrificial Dilemma](https://therapytips.org/interviews/new-research-reveals-how-people-make-moral-choices-in-a-real-life-sacrificial-dilemma.html): Interview with researcher on moral decision-making and ethical dilemmas in real-world
- [University Of Zurich Research Maps Out The Modern-Day 'Ecology Of Risk'](https://therapytips.org/interviews/university-of-zurich-research-maps-out-the-modern-day-ecology-of-risk.html): Interview on modern risk-taking in careers, finances, and everyday life decisions
